LESSON: ENGAGING PARENTS OR

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Care for the 3.3.2Communicating messages By the end of the sub-strand, the  Lea
Topic 3.3.3: Engaging parents or

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Engaging parents or. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the participation managing waste to parents or of parents or guardians in guardians during school events waste management 

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: ENGAGING PARENTS OR
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Engaging parents or helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: ENGAGING PARENTS OR
Study Engaging parents or like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate the participation managing waste to parents or of parents or guardians in guardians during school events waste management 

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the participation managing waste to parents or of parents or guardians in guardians during school events waste management . You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the participation managing waste to parents or of parents or guardians in guardians during school events waste management .
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Engaging parents or” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the participation managing waste to parents or of parents or guardians in guardians during school events waste management . Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Engaging parents or is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Engaging parents or” around your school. (skill: appreciate the participation managing waste to parents or of parents or guardians in guardians during school events waste management )

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Engaging parents or to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate the participation managing waste to parents or of parents or guardians in guardians during school events waste management .
3. Make one local Kenya example of Engaging parents or from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Engaging parents or: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study Engaging parents or?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Engaging parents or means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate the participation managing waste to parents or of parents or guardians in guardians during school events waste management .

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
